questions.q: Which sewing tool is specifically designed to safely cut and remove unwanted stitches from a piece of fabric?
questions.explain: A seam ripper is a small, pointed tool with a sharp hook used to slide under and easily cut away mistaken or temporary stitches without damaging the fabric.

questions.q: Pinking shears are special types of scissors that leave a zig-zag pattern on the fabric edge. What is the primary purpose of this tool?
options: To draw a curved line for the neckline.
To prevent woven fabrics from unraveling or fraying at the raw edges.
To permanently glue two fabrics together.
questions.explain: Pinking shears cut fabric with a serrated (zig-zag) edge, which stops the woven threads from pulling out and fraying easily compared to a straight cut.

questions.q: When making stuffed household articles like a basic soft toy or a pin cushion, which local material can be safely used as 'stuffing'?
options: Clean foam scraps, cotton wool, or soft fabric rags
Dry leaves that crumble into dust
questions.explain: Clean and soft materials like foam pieces, cotton wool, or leftover tailor shreds (rags) make safe, durable stuffing for soft crafts.
